headline: Steer clear of the tanker off Horn Island
what: The Coast Guard set a safety zone covering all water within 1,000 meters of the tanker KALAHARI while she makes repairs at anchor in the Pascagoula Anchorage.
why: Boats running the outside of the barrier islands or using Horn Island Pass need to go around a ship-sized no-go circle for two months.
todo: Plot the circle before you go. Permission to enter: COTP Mobile, VHF 16 or (251) 266-5888.

headline: Nights of Lights returns to St. Augustine
dateline: Nov 21 – Jan 18 · Light-Up! Night Sat Nov 21
what: About 3 million lights across the bayfront and historic downtown. Light-Up! Night opens it Sat Nov 21, with music from 4pm in the Plaza de la Constitución.
why: The lights sit right on the ICW by the Bridge of Lions – a classic stop for southbound snowbirds.
todo: Reserve a mooring or slip early for Nov 21 and the holiday weekends – they fill fast.
